summary: A Yes vote continues the existing one-half-cent countywide transactions and use tax after 2039 to fund transportation improvements and services.

tax.text: A Yes vote continues the countywide half-cent sales tax beyond 2039 to fund transportation infrastructure and services.
tax.quote: If approved by the voters, Measure A would continue the current countywide half-cent sales tax beyond the year 2039 and would not raise the current sales tax rate in Riverside County.

tax.text: A No vote does not renew the countywide half-cent sales tax beyond 2039.
tax.quote: If approved by the voters, Measure A would continue the current countywide half-cent sales tax beyond the year 2039 and would not raise the current sales tax rate in Riverside County.
